student_integration.integration_summary_notes: DTU runs an introduction week during which participants are assigned a buddy; a range of clubs and student associations are available to support integration.

academic.grading_system_summary: Scale 0–20; minimum passing grade is 10 for exchange students to transfer credits.

student_integration.language_course_details: Intensive French classes available prior to semester at Cavilam (Alliance Française of Vichy). Admitted double degree students are invited to a pre‑programme summer school focused on French language (costs not specified).
student_integration.integration_summary_notes: Welcome Desk and orientation events are provided (orientation in late August for fall/full year and late January for spring). Double degree students are invited to a pre‑start summer school to support integration and language skills.
